summary: Per-component 3-float vector addition: writes a3[0..2] = a1[0..2] + a2[0..2] and returns the output pointer a3. Invoked from vehicle geometry proximity and ray/triangle intersection paths.

operations.description: Compute and store x component: a3[0] = a1[0] + a2[0].
Compute and store y component: a3[1] = a1[1] + a2[1].
Compute and store z component: a3[2] = a1[2] + a2[2].
Return the output vector pointer a3.

unresolved: The raw source takes three separate float pointers; the packet records reads on this+0x0/0x4/0x8 only, so the containing object identity of a1/a2/a3 is unconfirmed.
The prelabel identifies a structural twin via cluster_copy, but the cluster representative address is outside the packet evidence and is not asserted.
